jobInfo.postDescription:
职位描述：
Software testing:
oDesign and execute a comprehensive software testing plan to ensure comprehensive coverage of functionality, performance, and stability.
oIdentify and report defects, actively collaborate with the development team to solve problems.
oPerform automated testing to improve testing efficiency.
Document writing:
oWrite clear and detailed user manuals and technical documentation to support users in fully understanding and effectively using software tools.
oUpdate and maintain documentation to ensure that it reflects the latest software features and changes.
oCollaborate with product and development teams to ensure documentation is synchronized with software development progress.
职位要求：
At least 2 years of relevant work experience, with experience in software testing and document writing.
Proficient in using relevant testing software.
Familiar with basic testing theories, such as black box and white box testing methods.
Communicate test results and document requirements clearly and effectively.
